name: zclass_world_build_active_light_list
description: zClass_World::BuildActiveLightList forwards a world's light node/data arrays and count to the zModel active-light builder.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zClass world wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x451540 validates loading world class-data fields lightNodes, lightDataList, and lightCount, then forwarding them to zModel_Light::BuildActiveLightList before returning zero.
The native world smoke verifies the wrapper passes the world light arrays/count through to zModel_Light_PointInPolygonInitXZ, updates the active-light globals, and returns zero.
